name: outbrain-mcp
description: Outbrain Amplify (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, pause_resume. Every tool maps

platform_mcp_outbrain_ob_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_OUTBRAIN_OB_TOKEN
platform_mcp_outbrain_ob_token.description: Amplify API token, sent as the OB-TOKEN-V1 header. Obtain it with `curl -u USER:PASSWORD https://api.outbrain.com/amplify/v0.1/login` (Basic auth; the response is {"OB-TOKEN-V1": "…"}); tokens last 30 days, so re-issue and replace it monthly. Amplify API access requires Outbrain's approval.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /marketers: the marketers (advertiser accounts) available to the token's user; there is no user endpoint.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /marketers: {marketers: [{id, name, enabled, …}], count}. The marketer currency is on its budgets, not on this record.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /marketers/{account_id}/campaigns?limit (≤50)&offset: the marketer's non-archived campaigns. `status` is onAirReason (e.g. RUNNING, CAMPAIGN_FLY_DATES_PAST); the enabled flag, cpc and amountSpent are in raw. `budget` is the campaign's budget object amount (a budget can be shared by several campaigns; its type DAILY/MONTHLY/CAMPAIGN is in raw.budget). The `status` argument is not sent.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /reports/marketers/{account_id}/periodic?from&to&breakdown=daily&limit=100[&campaignId]: one row per day (up to 100 days per call; totalResults gives the full count), for the marketer or, with campaign_id, one campaign. spend is in the marketer currency; today's figures lag 10–30 minutes. Reporting is limited to 30 requests per minute per marketer and 3 years of history.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: PUT /campaigns/{campaign_id} {"enabled": false|true} ('Update an Existing Campaign'; enabled is one of the updatable properties). pause sends enabled=false, resume enabled=true; the campaign's onAirReason (in list_campaigns) shows whether it is actually running.
